Proved soundness,
Theorem~\ref{thm:fol-lk-soundness}; honest completeness sketch,
Theorem~\ref{thm:fol-lk-completeness}.
text:
Proved soundness, Theorem~\ref{thm:fol-lk-soundness} and
\cref{thm:p07-eqlk-soundness}.  Proved finite-sequent completeness with
Cut: equality-free \cref{thm:p07-canonical-lk-completeness} (Choice for an
arbitrary signature only), without Choice for every signature
\cref{thm:p02-w02b-p02-019-choice-free}; identity
\cref{thm:p07-eqlk-completeness}, without Choice.  Two-way natural-deduction
maps at both hypotheses, \cref{thm:p02-w02b-p02-019-maps}.  The Cut/Mix-free
identity fragment is incomplete, \cref{thm:p07-eqlk-cut-failure}.  The
inherited Theorem~\ref{thm:fol-lk-completeness} remains a sketch; see
\cref{tab:p02-w02b-p02-019-lk-adequacy}.
reason: A-037-C02 / ED26-REQ-A-037-01: the LK row of tab:p02-fol-proof-systems cites only the proof sketch thm:fol-lk-completeness. The replacement enters the proved adequacy theorems at their language, equality and Choice hypotheses (written in handbook/parts/p02/first-order-calculi-and-equality-w02b-p02-019.tex, sec:p02-w02b-p02-019-lk-nd). Requires the driver input for that file so the new labels resolve.
